baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-najm at word 1, al-shajar at word 2, and their dual predicate yasjudan at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The inventory permits al-najm as stemless vegetation and al-shajar as woody stemmed growth. The dual verb joins ground-spreading and upright growth in one act of inclination, compressing the plant world into two contrasting postures.

activation_trace.role: Stemless ground growth supplies the low botanical member of the pair.
Woody stemmed growth supplies the upright botanical member of the pair.
Bowing and inclining under weight turns plant posture into embodied prostration.

changed_reading.before: A star and a tree perform worship.
changed_reading.after: Stemless growth and stemmed growth together enact prostration through contrasting but equally dependent postures.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rising-star sense of al-najm and the earth-rooted tree are coordinated by one dual verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: A light high above and a tree rising from below occupy opposite reaches of the visible world, yet grammatical duality gives them one lowered obedience. Altitude does not produce autonomy.

activation_trace.role: The rising star supplies the remote celestial pole of the vertical span.
The stemmed tree supplies the terrestrial pole of the vertical span.
Humble lowering gives both unlike heights the same obedient orientation.

changed_reading.before: Two natural objects happen to prostrate.
changed_reading.after: The highest visible light and earth-rooted growth form one vertical field whose every level is lowered in obedience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Branch senses within al-najm, al-shajar, and yasjudan permit a process reading without leaving the three focus words.
baseline_models.mechanism: Al-najm can image something coming forth, while al-shajar can image interwoven dispute or speech. Read processually, both fresh emergence and accumulated entanglement terminate in yielding rather than self-sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Something rising into view recasts al-najm as emergence rather than only an object.
Entangled dispute and speech makes branching a social as well as vegetal process.
Humble submission supplies the common endpoint for emergence and entanglement.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a static tableau of two worshipers.
changed_reading.after: Whatever newly emerges and whatever becomes interwoven remains answerable to a lowering limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sun, moon, and reckoning activate the celestial al-najm, while the following balance activates its projecting-marker branch. Sujud becomes exact participation in a measured system rather than an invisible gesture added to nature.

activation_trace.role: The rising star locates the focus subject within the neighboring celestial pair.
The visible projecting marker, including a balance crosspiece, links al-najm to measured orientation.
Obedient lowering becomes compliance with measure.
The sun supplies one explicit celestial body immediately before al-najm.
The moon and its sky-light supply the second measured celestial body.
Counting and calculation make regularity the mechanism joining the lights to sujud.
Balancing and aligning two things turns the dual celestial motion into coordinated measure.

structural_cues: 55:5 immediately precedes the focus with two celestial nouns governed by bi-husban.
55:7-9 repeats al-mizan and frames order as neither transgression nor deficit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired lights, calculation, a visible marker, and balance; I infer that their calibrated paths are the directional form of sujud. A live alternative is that the sequence merely juxtaposes separate signs.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic bodies worship in an unspecified way.
changed_reading.after: Their prostration is publicly measurable: paired lights and visible markers stay aligned without overrunning their measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sits between a calculated heaven and the sequence of sky raised, balance placed, and earth placed. The rising branch of al-najm and the lowering branch of sujud make 55:6 a hinge where ascent is answered by emplacement and inclination.

activation_trace.role: Rising into view supplies the upward motion that the context counterbalances.
The upright stem makes vertical extension materially visible.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the answering downward motion.
Height and elevation establish the upper field around the focus.
Raising supplies explicit ascent immediately after yasjudan.
Placing something in a lower or fixed position supplies the counter-motion to raising.
The lower realm opposite the sky completes the vertical axis.

structural_cues: 55:7 follows yasjudan with a raised sky and a placed balance.
55:10 repeats the placement verb for the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit up and down motions around the focus; I infer a hinge in which rising is governed by the capacity to lower into place. The alternative is a noncausal rhetorical sequence.

changed_reading.before: The verse names two already-formed subjects that bow.
changed_reading.after: It stages a vertical law: whatever rises or stands is defined by its capacity to incline into an assigned place.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth that grows, germinating grain, shed husk, and aromatic leaf expand the botanical baseline into a material cycle. Sujud is enacted through dependence on soil, growth, fragmentation, and exposure rather than by plants imitating a human ritual.

activation_trace.role: Stemless ground growth anchors the low layer of the ecological field.
Woody stemmed growth anchors the elevated layer of the ecological field.
Inclination under weight lets material plant behavior carry the force of sujud.
Soft growing earth supplies the substrate on which both plant forms depend.
The germinating grain supplies emergence and reproductive load.
Fragmented husk and crop leaf supply the plant's shedding and exposure.
Aromatic plant and leaf complete the living botanical continuum.

structural_cues: 55:10-12 immediately develops earth, fruit, palm, grain, husk, and aromatic growth after the focus.
The sequence moves from whole habitat to reproductive and discarded plant material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the substrate and plant-cycle parts; I infer that they unpack how najm and shajar prostrate materially. The live alternative is that the list only supplies examples of bounty after an independent worship claim.

changed_reading.before: Plants are personified as ritual worshipers.
changed_reading.after: Sujud is an ecology-wide posture: germination, low spread, woody ascent, husk-shedding, and leafing all disclose material dependence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later seas mix and meet while a between-relation blocks transgression. This activates the disputed-entanglement branch of shajar: sujud need not erase contact, difference, or tension, but can be the limit that keeps interlacing from becoming violation.

activation_trace.role: Entangled dispute and speech supplies a social mechanism beneath the tree image.
Submission supplies restraint without requiring the relation to disappear.
Mixing and disturbance activate a state of live entanglement.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies actual encounter rather than separation.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies a relation that also mediates them.
Crossing a limit through aggression names the motion that bounded sujud prevents.

structural_cues: 55:19 gives a dual pair that meets.
55:20 preserves both the between-space and the prohibition on either member transgressing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mixing, encounter, mediation, and non-transgression; I infer that submission is the governing boundary of entanglement. A live alternative is that the sea scene has no social force on shajar.

changed_reading.before: Sujud means conflict-free submission by isolated entities.
changed_reading.after: The pair's prostration can name disciplined relation: interlacing and encounter persist, while rivalry yields at a limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The emergent branch of al-najm is placed against later cessation, remaining, asking, and recurrent time. Celestial and vegetal forms prostrate not only spatially but temporally: they appear, pass, and repeatedly depend.

activation_trace.role: Rising into appearance supplies the beginning of a finite temporal arc.
Living woody growth supplies a visibly time-bound created form.
Submission becomes dependence across duration rather than one isolated posture.
Cessation after persistence supplies the terminal edge of created emergence.
Continuance supplies the contrast against which finite forms are read.
Asking and requesting turns finite existence into ongoing dependence.
A duration of time gives that dependence a recurrent temporal frame.

structural_cues: 55:26 says everyone upon the earth passes away.
55:27 contrasts that passing with what remains.
55:29 says all in the heavens and earth ask in recurrent time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appearance, cessation, continuance, request, and duration; I infer a temporal arc as a mode of sujud. The alternative is that sujud remains purely spatial while these later claims are separate.

changed_reading.before: Prostration is a posture performed by stable natural objects.
changed_reading.after: Prostration is also their time-structure: emergent celestial and vegetal forms pass and continually depend, while permanence lies beyond them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus coordinates two unlike singular subjects with a dual verb. Later balancing, meeting, and explicit pairing make the dual itself active: sujud is the relation that lets difference operate together without collapse into sameness.

activation_trace.role: The celestial star supplies one unlike member of the focus dyad.
The woody tree supplies the contrasting member of the focus dyad.
Shared submission is the single relation grammatically holding the two subjects together.
Alignment between two things supplies coordinated difference rather than fusion.
Two opposing things meeting supplies a dynamic model for dual relation.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart makes pairing an explicit organizing image.

structural_cues: The focus has two coordinated singular nouns but a dual verb.
The surah repeatedly uses dual forms for east and west, seas, gardens, springs, and fruit pairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring dual grammar plus branches of alignment, meeting, and pairing; I infer that shared sujud is relational coordination. The live alternative is that repetition of duals is thematic ornament without syntactic force on 55:6.

changed_reading.before: Two independent entities happen to share a predicate.
changed_reading.after: Sujud is what makes unlike counterparts a functioning pair: neither merges with the other nor acts alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later branching boughs, fruit taken from its growth-place, and an upper thing drawing down toward the middle provide a material completion of the tree's bowing. Productive ascent culminates in descent that makes yield accessible.

activation_trace.role: Ground-level vegetation keeps productive descent tied to the full plant pair.
The woody stem supplies the fruit-bearing structure capable of bending.
Inclining under weight gives the bough's descent the posture of sujud.
A branching bough supplies the extended structure on which yield can descend.
Taking fruit from its place of growth supplies the productive result of the bowed branch.
An upper thing lowering toward the middle supplies the precise directional motion.

structural_cues: 55:48 names branching forms within the paired gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bough, harvest, and downward nearness; I infer that productive load draws the branch into a giving bow. A live alternative is nearness by arrangement rather than by fruit-weight.

changed_reading.before: The tree bows as a bare sign of submission.
changed_reading.after: The tree's prostration is productive descent: fruit-bearing boughs lower what they generate into reach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a later sky phase-change back into ordinary yasjudan. It remains anchored through celestial al-najm and bodily lowering, but downstream prose should present it as a contrast between continuous and catastrophic yielding, not claim that sajada lexically means rupture.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The celestial branch of al-najm and the bending branch of yasjudan keep the later sky transformation attached to 55:6.

activation_trace.role: The rising star anchors the outlier in the celestial subject of the focus.
Bending and lowering provide the shared directional core of ordinary and catastrophic yielding.
Splitting open supplies catastrophic loss of the sky's stable posture.
Abased submission within becoming makes the phase-change unexpectedly echo sujud.
Flower-red color gives the transformed sky an organic visual echo of the tree.
Oil or coating supplies the liquefied material register of the collapse.

changed_reading.before: Natural prostration is only calm regularity.
changed_reading.after: The focus may prefigure two scales of yielding: continuous measured inclination now and catastrophic cosmic loss of posture later.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a judgment scene is used as a bodily foil for nonhuman sujud. It remains anchored in the focus root's prostration-limb branch, but should be rendered as a contrastive activation, not as an assertion that stars or trees possess human anatomy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yasjudan carries a branch of prostration limbs, forehead, and bodily mark that can be contrasted with the later seizure of opposite bodily extremities.

activation_trace.role: Prostration limbs and the forehead mark supply the bodily geometry retained from the focus.
Seizure and capture change willing or constitutive lowering into forced handling.
The forelock as a point of seizure supplies the body's upper extremity.
The feet supply the opposite extremity, completing a forcibly folded body.

changed_reading.before: All submission has the same generic force.
changed_reading.after: The focus can be heard as unforced whole-form yielding, later contrasted with culpable bodies seized from forelock to feet.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the closing baraka inventory with plant and prostration branches. It remains anchored in stemless and stemmed growth plus the forehead-ground posture, but prose should mark the ground-pressure-to-flourishing arrow as an abductive echo rather than an etymological equation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both botanical subjects and the grounded bodily branch of yasjudan remain explicit focus anchors.

activation_trace.role: Stemless growth supplies life already spread close to the ground.
Woody growth supplies stable increase rising from grounded roots.
The forehead and prostration limbs supply bodily contact with the ground.
A chest adhering to and pressing the ground mirrors the physical posture of prostration.
Fixed growing good turns grounded stability into generative increase.

changed_reading.before: Lowering is only diminishment or negation of agency.
changed_reading.after: Lowering and flourishing can coexist: grounded pressure becomes the posture in which stable increase takes root.

strongest_changes: Husban and mizan changed celestial sujud from generic worship into measurable non-transgression and alignment.
Earth, grain, husk, leaf, bough, and near harvest changed botanical sujud into material dependence and productive descent.
Recurring duals changed the shared predicate into relational coordination of unlike counterparts.
Meeting seas and their boundary preserved entanglement under restraint instead of resolving difference.
summary.what_was_special: The lexical fork in al-najm, together with vegetal and social branches of al-shajar, kept cosmic, ecological, temporal, and relational readings simultaneously live. The strangest productive activation was that lowering could be generative: fruit comes down into reach, and the closing baraka branches pair ground-pressure with stable growth.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether al-najm is celestial, stemless vegetation, or deliberately carries both horizons.
How much weight the dispute-entanglement branch of shajar can bear in this nominal context.
Whether fruit-load and baraka ground-pressure are intended material mechanisms or branch-induced echoes.
The catastrophic and compelled-fold readings are contrastive activations, not secure direct senses of 55:6.
